chapter: Bunk Johnson and the New Orleans scene
title: Was Bunk's late playing representative of his early years?
summary: The interviewer asks whether Bunk at 68 or 69 showed what he could do earlier; Mike cannot say.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: That's not even the point yet. The point is, do you think that, do you personally think that Bonk, at the age of 68 or 69, Bonk, turned in a pretty good representation of what he could do back in the early days?
I don't, I don't think that.
I couldn't, I couldn't think that myself. I know, a lot, a lot of, uh... Do you think he was fairly taken? Huh? Do you think he was fairly taken about it?
